method: Manual comparison of four frames per preset and full MP4 decode

decisions.observation: Four sampled frames show clockwise and counterclockwise center rotation, with the scene covering every corner; this reads as a rhythmic camera swing distinct from horizontal handheld motion and color-split effects.

Four sampled frames move the horizon and foreground laterally with smaller vertical displacement, while retaining full-frame coverage; the straight horizon and jittered crop distinguish it from rotational rhythm swing.
